definitions.gloss: full effort, all one's strength, utmost power
definitions.explanation: Putting everything one has into an action. Used for both physical exertion and mental or emotional commitment.

examples.japanese: {全力|ぜんりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧{全力|ぜんりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}した→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I studied with all my effort for the exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{全力|ぜんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くして→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧⟦{戦|たたか}った→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of every team member giving their all, we were able to win the championship.

notes:
Often used with で as an adverbial phrase: {全力|ぜんりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (with all one's might).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全力|ぜんりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (run at full speed)
- {全力|ぜんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧ (give one's all, exhaust one's efforts)
- {全力|ぜんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (put out full effort)
- {全力|ぜんりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧ (tackle something with full effort)
- {全力投球|ぜんりょくとうきゅう} (giving it everything — literally "full-power pitch")

{全力|ぜんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧ is a common set phrase meaning to do one's absolute best, often used in speeches and formal encouragement.
